label: settlement-ready
title: Settlement inputs
body: Bounded server model: two immutable run identities, each with Trace Credit and one external instrument. Account earned/referral payouts have a separate identity space.

label: settlement-progress
title: Instrument progress
body: Settle persists its selection before index or settlement effects. Each instrument progresses independently; an internal credit transaction records the ledger, batch when applicable, and completed leg together.

label: settlement-uncertain
title: External effect, uncertain local record
body: An adapter or transfer may have succeeded before the local record commits. A retry keeps the same operation identity; a lost response is not evidence that no effect occurred.

label: pipeline-near
title: Pipeline NEAR outbox
body: Finalized Trace Credit batches use their own NEAR outbox. A new dispatch needs runnable policy; confirmation of a stored submitted line reads the original key and submission mode.

label: account-payout
title: Account NEAR AI transfers
body: Earned and referral streams use account links, cumulative target lines and receipt recovery on the NEAR AI rail. These transfers do not use pipeline NEAR outbox identities.

label: settlement-held
title: Dispatch or account work held
body: Policy, shared account standing and stream-specific holds gate their own work. Already completed settlement legs remain complete after withdrawal; referral holds do not stop earned sends.
